login_registration.detail: Dedicated LaunchAgent and RunAtLoad; registration alone is not login proof.

startup_rendering.detail: At least one display advances real frames and all animation clocks.

native_menu.detail: Native menu delegate event; not a browser control.

native_feed.detail: Native Feed event plus actual food counter; feeding appearance still requires observation.

native_pause_resume.detail: At least 5 seconds frozen, followed by actual native Resume and advancing frames.

native_quit.detail: Native Quit event followed by application termination.

system_sleep_wake.detail: Matched OS system sleep/wake plus subsequent animation; lock/display sleep alone cannot pass.

relogin_autostart.detail: New GUI audit session, registered agent process, actual launch rendering, and matching saved settings.

dock.detail: Requires user observation; native app logs cannot prove this.

desktop_drag.detail: Requires user observation; native app logs cannot prove this.

visual_after_wake.detail: Requires user observation; native app logs cannot prove this.

visual_after_login.detail: Requires user observation; native app logs cannot prove this.
